reason: Panormitanus's consilia are cited as *cõſeil* in the same annotation's note {o} (*Panorme au cõſeil preallegue*) and as *conseil* at annot-027 and annot-028; *cõſil* has no parallel in the book.

The title is *De libero homine exhibendo* (D. 43.29), the interdict for producing a detained free man, which is the point of Coras's second sense of *arrest*; annot-086's margin prints the same title as *D. de lib. ho. exhib.*, so the *ho* of reading B is expected and reading A drops it.

The work is Lactantius, *De falsa sapientia* (Inst. III), printed correctly as *de falſæ ſapientia* in note {g} of the same annotation; *ſapietia* is *ſapiẽtia* with the tilde lost, a common print feature, whereas *ſapieria* requires a t/r error.
